description: This file declares the SetMute class, which is a task for setting mute state in a media player context within the Rialto server's generic tasks namespace. It includes class members, constructor, destructor, and an execute method, along with private members for context, a wrapper, and mute state.

classes.name: SetMute
classes.description: A class representing a task to set mute state in the media player, implementing the IPlayerTask interface.

methods.name: SetMute
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the task with the player context, GST wrapper, and mute state.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task to set the mute state in the media player.
